description: Synthetic: weighed lines with a printed price per kg (3-decimal quantities) and the pack-size forms of a product name: `2KG`, `4X125G` (multipack), `6X1,5L`, `8 role`.
notes: Receipt-level case: invented data and no source. Use `fixture.expected` directly.
Weighed lines have qtyUnit `kg`, a 3-decimal qty and unitPriceBani per kg: lineTotalBani = round(qty * unitPriceBani), i.e. 1,234 kg * 5,99 = 7,39 and 0,456 kg * 38,90 = 17,74.
Multipacks give the whole content: `4X125G` = 500 g, `6X1,5L` = 9 l (parsePackSize; `pack` is the content of ONE sold unit).
Only the VAT amounts are printed (the Lidl convention), so totals.vat has no net or gross. Classes: A = 21%, B = 11%.
